name: create-flow
summary: A new purchase order: a three-step wizard dialog with a live preview, a review and a draft kept on reload.
ports: supplier: the supplier the order starts with, typed { id, name, leadDays }
suppliers: the supplier options of the supplier step
parts: the parts the line step offers, matched to the chosen supplier, typed { id, sku, name, supplierId, unitCost }
now: the reading time in ms, the due day defaults to the quoted lead time from it
open: boolean, the dialog state the caller owns
onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void, the dialog state setter the caller owns
